title: Waterfront Work-Leisure Workplace
role: Studio requirements. These figures are not a calculated building-performance assessment.

plan.note: The studio site is about 270,600 square feet, 330 by 820 feet. It is not the county property area and it is not the imported parcel ring.

intention: A workplace integrating focused work, collaborative work, and public waterfront gathering throughout the day.

occupancy.simultaneous: The 1,500 badge holders and visitors are not assumed to be on site at the same time.

limits: Daytime work, evening gathering, and badge-holder figures are brief requirements. Skill 5 does not check whether a composition meets them.
Module envelopes are not converted into usable floor area or occupant capacity.
